set.layering_notes: Revenue has been thin; the in-lieu fee was reset by Resolution 2023-056 (rescinding Resolution 2012-071) with Ordinance 1719-NS, effective November 24, 2023, and the linkage fee is $0. The City has used land instead: it donated Hillcrest area land to the Housing Land Trust Ventura County for a 78-unit for-sale townhome project with People's Self-Help Housing, provided City land for a navigation center, and partnered with the County on Step Up (77 extremely low income PSH units). A PLHA grant went to HTFVC as Local Housing Trust Fund match in FY 2021-22. For rental gap, look first to the County PLHA plan (which covers Thousand Oaks), the County HOME Consortium and HTFVC. Ordinance 1750-NS (Section 8-2.06 and Title 9, Chapter 10, Article 9), introduced September 15, 2026 and on the September 29, 2026 agenda for adoption, exempts for-sale affordable housing projects from certain development impact fees; Council also took up Hillcrest Homes DDA and project modifications in April and October 2026.
